_doc: Questions that test the same fact as another question: a sister ladder's twin or a rung that re-asks its neighbour. The quiz engine asks one per run and counts the others as shown (src/quiz_engine.py, playtest 2026-10-24). Built from _cards/variants: 476 cross-ladder pairs (a word-overlap scan, each pair confirmed by a judge, 99% precision) and the within-ladder twins two judges found in a 160-ladder sample, plus Brandon's two named examples. A rewrite pass that replaces the extra rungs with new facts would retire this file.
